title: Oven Braised Filipino Beets Leche Flan
description: A pungent and flaky Filipino dish featuring beets in a leche flan form, perfect for crowds, this recipe is high in protein and braised to perfection in a ramekin vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, puree the beets until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the pureed beets to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Strain the mixture into a clean bowl to remove any air bubbles.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and braise for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
